/* gen-tls13get-fixture.cx -- one-off generator for tests/fixtures/tls13get/chain-badsig.bin.
 *
 *   sh ./unisacc.com tools/gen-tls13get-fixture.cx -- [OUT]
 *
 * 把 tests/fixtures/tls/syn-cert.bin 的叶证书与 tests/fixtures/tls/syn-cert-other.bin 的叶证书,
 * 拼成一条合法的 framed TLS Certificate 握手消息(type 11, ctx len 0, 两个证书条目)。第二张的发行者/密钥
 * 与第一张不连,verify_sig 必拒 -> 用作'链签名错'夹具。确定性来源:syn-cert*.bin 由 H4 的确定性生成器产
 * (固定 P-256 私钥、nonce=sha256(key||digest));本器只做字节拼接,无随机。 */
#pragma unisa use sys.fs
#pragma unisa use sys.io
#pragma unisa use sys.posix
#pragma unisa use text.text
#pragma unisa use mem.heap

static unsigned char *rd(const char *p, size_t *n) { return (unsigned char *)cx_read(p, n); }
static int entry(const unsigned char *b, size_t n, const unsigned char **e, long *el) {
    long l;
    if (!b || n < 12) return 1;
    /* type(1)+len(3)+ctxlen(1)+listlen(3)+entry[ len(3)+der ] */
    l = ((long)b[8] << 16) | ((long)b[9] << 8) | (long)b[10];
    if (l <= 0 || (size_t)(8 + 3 + l) > n) return 1;
    *e = b + 8;
    *el = 3 + l;
    return 0;
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    const char *out = argc >= 2 ? argv[1] : "tests/fixtures/tls13get/chain-badsig.bin";
    size_t an = 0, bn = 0;
    unsigned char *a = rd("tests/fixtures/tls/syn-cert.bin", &an);
    unsigned char *b = rd("tests/fixtures/tls/syn-cert-other.bin", &bn);
    const unsigned char *e1, *e2; long l1, l2, list, body, o;
    unsigned char *m;
    if (!a || !b) { fprintf(stderr, "gen: read fixtures\n"); return 2; }
    if (entry(a, an, &e1, &l1) || entry(b, bn, &e2, &l2)) { fprintf(stderr, "gen: parse entry\n"); return 2; }
    list = l1 + l2;
    body = 1 + 3 + list;          /* ctxlen(1)+listlen(3)+list */
    m = (unsigned char *)mm_alloc(4 + body);
    if (!m) { fprintf(stderr, "gen: alloc\n"); return 2; }
    m[0] = 0x0b;
    m[1] = (unsigned char)((body >> 16) & 255); m[2] = (unsigned char)((body >> 8) & 255); m[3] = (unsigned char)(body & 255);
    m[4] = 0;                     /* ctx len 0 */
    m[5] = (unsigned char)((list >> 16) & 255); m[6] = (unsigned char)((list >> 8) & 255); m[7] = (unsigned char)(list & 255);
    o = 8;
    memcpy(m + o, e1, (size_t)l1); o += l1;
    memcpy(m + o, e2, (size_t)l2); o += l2;
    { char dir[2200]; long dl = 0, last = -1;
      while (out[dl]) { if (out[dl] == '/') last = dl; dl++; }
      if (last > 0 && last < (long)sizeof dir) { memcpy(dir, out, (size_t)last); dir[last] = 0; sy_mkdir_all(dir, 0700); } }
    if (cx_write(out, m, (size_t)(4 + body))) { fprintf(stderr, "gen: write %s\n", out); return 2; }
    printf("GEN_CHAIN_BADSIG\t%s\tbytes=%ld\tleaf=%ld\tsecond=%ld\n", out, 4 + body, l1, l2);
    mm_free(m); mm_free(a); mm_free(b);
    return 0;
}
